integrity: The trace-zero coordinate set and evaluation code are independently reconstructed over \(\mathbb F_8\). The published length, dimension, and ordinary weight enumerator are reproduced before higher-support calculations are accepted. All \(29211\) positive-dimensional message subspaces are then enumerated exactly once in reduced-row-echelon form.
scientific_limitations: The result is an exact finite higher-support census for the \(m=3\) member of the family in Theorem 3.9 and Example 3.11. It does not give a closed all-\(m\) formula and does not classify subcodes up to automorphism.
title: Complete higher-support profile of the \([37,7,16]_2\) subfield code
